text.en:
Adjustment of Dividend Rate. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No.
7656, the percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the
PHILGUARANTEE to the National Government for CYs 2019 and 2020 is adjusted
from fifty percent (50%) of its annual net earnings to 0%.

Coverage. The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this
Order is only applicable to PHILGUARANTEE for CYs 2019 and 2020.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 6th dayof December
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-One.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
